sentences.text: Mr. Prince Chauhan, learned counsel for the respondent no.2-informant and the wife of the applicant no.1.
5. Applicants are present in-person.
They are identified by Mr. Shariq Khurshid, Advocate.
6. The respondent no.2 is present in-person.
She is identified by Mr. Prince Chauhan, Advocate.
7. Both, the applicants and the respondent no.2 submitted that there were some matrimonial disputes.
They have resolved their disputes.
They have filed a Compounding Application (IA No.1 of 2025) and affidavits with their free will and without any pressure.
8. The applicant no.1 and the respondent no.2 submitted that they are living together.
The respondent no.2 has requested to quash the entire proceedings of the said Criminal Case No.11 of 2022 9.

The said request has not been opposed by the respondent no.1.
10.

Considering the totality of the matter, this Court is of the view that ends of justice would be met if the entire proceedings of Criminal Case No.11 of 2022, "State of Uttarakhand vs. Mohd. Asif and Others", pending before the court of learned Judicial Magistrate, Jaspur, District Udham Singh Nagar, are quashed.
